conviction_note: The baseline's anchors are both wrong, so I rebuilt the reaction base rate from the four 6-Ks I could confirm were real earnings releases by EDGAR acceptance time and call time: -20.4%, +1.1%, +2.3%, -18.1%, mean signed -8.8% and median absolute 10.2% against the baseline's 3.73% median and 4-up/4-down split; on top of that base rate, the company announced a $30m financing commitment from a lender with no independent public footprint at 08:46 ET on the morning of its own print and the tape paid +0.37% for it on roughly a fifth of normal volume, which is the sequencing of a company covering a cash number rather than a repricing event, so I sized the day below the two big historical prints but well outside the baseline's band.

findings.finding: The baseline's reaction history contains no earnings events; rebuilt from the four confirmed earnings 6-Ks (2025-09-15 BMO, acceptance 08:51:11 ET, -20.4%; 2025-12-15 BMO, 10:30 ET call, +1.1%; 2026-03-12 BMO, acceptance 08:32:36 ET, +2.3%; 2026-07-22 AMC, acceptance 16:59:13 ET, -18.1%) the mean signed reaction is -8.8% and the median absolute reaction is 10.2%, and both double-digit moves were falls that followed headlines reading 'Record $7.6 Million Quarterly Revenue, 45% Growth' and 'Revenue Up 46%'.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline itself carries cadence_implausible=true and a 7-day inferred cadence, i.e. the tool that built it matched monthly operational 6-Ks, not earnings; there is no option chain, so nothing in the price states an expected move at all. If a 10% median earnings reaction were priced there would be a bid straddle and a visible pre-print premium in a $1.31 nano-cap; instead the 5-day run-up is +0.38% and total front-expiry open interest is 14 contracts. Note also this Q1 print moves to a 17:00 ET call after four consecutive quarters reported BMO at 10:30 ET.
findings.independence: Session timing independently confirmed from SEC acceptance stamps rather than price data: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1715925/000119312525202896/0001193125-25-202896-index-headers.html (20250915085111) and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1715925/000119312526103147/0001193125-26-103147-index-headers.html (20260312083236).

findings.finding: At 08:46 ET on the morning of its own AMC print MindWalk announced a 'binding commitment' for a US$30m senior unsecured revolving facility from 'Sanabil (Cayman)' at 7.00% fixed with no maintenance covenants, no warrants, no equity conversion, no asset pledge, no MAC closing condition and no unused-line fee, with a definitive agreement still to be negotiated and a 60-day target close - terms no lender extends to an issuer whose 20-F filed eight weeks earlier says it 'does not have sufficient cash reserves to fund operations for the next twelve months', and the counterparty has no public existence outside this press release.
findings.why_not_priced: The tape has had this all session and refuses to price it in either direction: +0.37% on the day against a 20-day average volume of 103,846 shares, on a facility equal to 49% of the $61m market cap at a company with C$11.5m of cash and C$12.5m of FY2026 operating burn. A market that believed it would have repriced a going-concern nano-cap by tens of percent; a market that had examined and rejected it would show the stock down. Neither happened, so what is actually priced is nothing, and the unpriced content is the inference the sequencing carries - a company puts a funding headline out hours before a print when it knows the balance sheet in that print needs cover. The range is wide and crosses zero because a facility validated with a named, checkable lender on the 17:00 call is genuinely good news the market has assigned zero value to.
findings.independence: The going-concern and 'insufficient cash reserves for twelve months' language is a separate document, the FY2026 20-F filed 2026-07-22: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/HYFT/20-f-mind-walk-holdings-corp-files-annual-report-foreign-issuer-86aa4813ce66.html . Release timestamp of 08:46 ET independently from https://www.stocktitan.net/news/HYFT/mind-walk-lands-binding-commitment-for-us-30-million-unsecured-mvu6m8ug96ju.html . This finding and the ATM finding below both bear on management's funding narrative; they rest on different documents but should not be read as fully independent.

findings.finding: Revenue has been flat for three consecutive quarters - Q2 FY2026 ~C$4.1m, Q3 FY2026 C$4.2m, Q4 FY2026 C$4.1m - so the 'Revenue Up 46%' full-year headline is entirely the Q1 FY2026 continuing-operations base of C$3.2m, and the two contracted recurring LensAI agreements signed in H2 FY2026 produced no visible sequential lift; tonight's Q1 FY2027 prints a strong YoY against that C$3.2m base while almost certainly marking a fourth flat sequential quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Every company communication frames growth year-over-year and never sequentially, and the prior-year Q1 was published as 'Record $7.6 Million Quarterly Revenue' - a total-company number including the since-divested Netherlands subsidiary - with the C$3.2m continuing-operations figure buried in the body. The wire copy tonight will therefore compare against either $7.6m or $3.2m, and neither comparison shows the flatline. If the stalled sequential line were focused on, a company that rebranded itself as AI infrastructure would not still trade on a growth multiple and the sell-side note would not be a reiterated Buy on a SaaS deal.
findings.independence: The C$3.2m continuing-operations Q1 FY2026 base and the $7.6m headline are from a different release: https://finance.yahoo.com/news/mindwalk-holdings-corp-formerly-immunoprecise-124400365.html . Q4 FY2026 C$4.1m from https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1715925/000119312526312521/hyft-ex99_1.htm .

findings.finding: A paid promotional campaign on HYFT has been running since 2026-09-03 - Market Equities Limited (Ireland), paid by Creative Direct Marketing Group and stating it 'expects to receive further compensation as part of an ongoing digital media effort' - at the same time as the company's audit committee sits non-compliant with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5605(c)(2) following director Kamil Isaev's forced resignation, and the FY2026 20-F discloses a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting.
findings.why_not_priced: The promotion is a GlobeNewswire item with the compensation disclosure at the bottom, not a filing, so it is in no aggregator's event feed; the audit-committee defect is a paragraph in an F-3/A, not an 8-K-equivalent announcement, and an FPI has no 8-K obligation to flag it. If either were focused on, the 20-day run-up would not be only -6.03% with the stock still 30% above its 52-week low, and the promotion campaign - eleven days old - would have shown up as a volume spike rather than 22k shares traded on facility-announcement day.
findings.independence: The audit-committee non-compliance and the Isaev resignation are from the F-3/A filed 2026-07-27: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1715925/000119312526318314/d57244df3a.htm . The ICFR material weakness is from the 20-F: https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/HYFT/20-f-mind-walk-holdings-corp-files-annual-report-foreign-issuer-86aa4813ce66.html . Three separate documents.

findings.finding: The CEO's line this morning that the facility funds the business 'without issuing a single share' is contradicted by the 20-F's own disclosure that 357,760 ATM shares were sold between May and July 2026 for $0.5m net - inside the exact quarter being reported tonight - with roughly $28.6m of the $30m JonesTrading ATM still available under a $250m shelf that went effective 2026-07-31; tonight's cash-flow statement is where that in-quarter issuance appears.
findings.why_not_priced: Weighted-average share count already moved 33.4m to 46.4m year over year, so the dilution channel is live, but the specific May-July issuance sits in a 20-F liquidity paragraph and has never been in a press release. Had the market connected it to this morning's no-dilution framing, the facility headline would have drawn a negative rather than a flat tape.
findings.independence: ATM program size and remaining capacity independently in the F-3/A: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1715925/000119312526318314/d57244df3a.htm . Shares this with finding 2 in that both concern the funding narrative - treat as one cluster with finding 2 if the scorer collapses on overlap of argument rather than document.

searched_and_found_nothing: Named counterparties for the two contracted recurring LensAI agreements - both are described only as 'largest enterprise AI client' and 'primary in silico pharmaceutical client'; no customer-side announcement exists to cross-check against, so no supplier/customer triangulation was possible

Any operational or contract news between 2026-07-23 and 2026-09-08 - the 47-day gap looked like a collapse in announcement cadence until I checked the 2026-03-31 to 2026-05-18 gap of 48 days, which is the same; the cadence is lumpy and this is not an anomaly
Short interest as a catalyst - 952.6k shares, 2.2% of a 42.6m float, gives no squeeze fuel and no crowded-short unwind in either direction, so it does not move my number

Any Cayman registry, website, prior transaction or press footprint for 'Sanabil (Cayman)' - the only sources describing it are the company's own 2026-09-14 release and its syndications; I could neither confirm nor refute the entity, and I have deliberately not claimed it does not exist

Any renewed Nasdaq minimum-bid-price deficiency notice - the August 2024 notice was cured by 2025-07-10 and at $1.31 there is headroom; the only live listing defect is the audit-committee composition rule
Hiring pages, app-store data and customer forums - not applicable to an enterprise B2B platform of this size; no usable signal
A live option chain or any priced directional statement - total front-expiry open interest is 14 contracts with no two-sided ATM market, so skew is genuinely unavailable rather than merely unhelpful
baseline_tension: It cuts against the free control, which reads the -6.03% 20-day run-up as a mild positive, and it cuts hard against the baseline's own 3.73% expected move and balanced 4-up/4-down history - both of which are artefacts of a cadence matcher that latched onto operational 6-Ks rather than earnings, and there is no skew to agree or disagree with because the chain is unusable.
